title.value: Energy efficiency as a normative account for predictive coding
title.justification: The title of the paper is given at the start of the document, which reads: 'Energy efficiency as a normative account for predictive coding'.
title.quote: Energy efficiency as a normative account for predictive coding

extractions.description: This paper explores the concept of predictive coding in artificial neural networks with an emphasis on energy efficiency. It delves into the theory that predictive coding is an emergent property of neural networks when they are optimized for energy efficiency. The study demonstrates that predictive coding not only emerges but is linked to energy minimization strategies in computational models. It provides insights into why brains may have evolved to implement predictive coding from an energy efficiency perspective.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: Although the paper discusses energy efficiency in the context of neural networks and brain function, it does not specifically relate this to broader ecological or climate-oriented sustainable development goals. The focus is more on understanding brain function and computational efficiency rather than environmental impacts or sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The results offer an explanation for why brains may implement predictive coding... Ali et al. demonstrate that predictive coding emerges in an artificial neural network optimized to be energy efficient.
